title: Data-Driven Text Adventure Engine
requirements: World defined in a text/INI file (rooms, exits, items, NPC lines) — no game content in code!
Parser for verbs: `go`, `take`, `drop`, `use X on Y`, `talk`, `look`, `inventory`
Conditions & events as a `std::variant` of action types handled with `std::visit`
Save/load game state to a file
Write a short 10-room adventure to ship with it
